title: Chainsaw Man
source: Chainsaw Man manga by Tatsuki Fujimoto. Part 1 (Public Safety saga) is finished; Part 2 (Academy saga) is used only for Denji's latest arc.
world: In a Japan where Devils are born from human fears, poor teenager Denji merges with his chainsaw devil-dog Pochita and becomes Chainsaw Man. He is recruited by Makima into Public Safety Devil Hunters, living with Aki and the Blood Fiend Power. Part 1 builds a strange found family and ends in tragedy when Makima's true nature as the Control Devil is revealed. Part 2 follows Denji as a high-school student. Chaotic, violent, funny and sad.
power_system: Devils are named after fears; the more feared, the stronger. Humans make contracts with devils, paying with things like lifespan or body parts. Fiends are devils in human corpses (like Power); Hybrids like Denji and Reze can transform. Chainsaw Man can erase a devil from existence by eating it.

timeline.summary: Denji becomes Chainsaw Man and joins Public Safety.
Trapped in a hotel; the team bonds.
Denji falls for Reze, a Soviet hybrid; Makima stops her.
Aki becomes the Gun Fiend; Makima's plan unfolds; Power is killed.

Denji in high school with Nayuta; Asa Mitaka and the War Devil Yoru; the Chainsaw Man Church, Fami (really the Death Devil) and Barem; Pochita erases himself and Denji wakes in a new world where Power is alive (ended 25 March 2026).
